title: Dodge the Dots
description: Steer a glowing orb through a neon storm of dots. Grab stars, catch shields, and chase close calls.

title: Bottle Flip
description: Time your tap to land the flip. Sloshing liquid, real tip-over physics, and it gets harder every time.

title: Rope Swing
description: Hold to grapple, let go to fling. Swing hook to hook over a lake of lava, and watch out for the ones that crumble.

title: Brick Storm
description: Brick breaker where the wall keeps sinking toward you. Smash it with Blaster, Tesla, Nova and multiball before it lands.

title: Wild Wings
description: Fly a little bird in 3D, right behind it, over the ocean, forest, city and snowy peaks. Dodge swordfish, hawks, planes and icicles, grab power-ups, or steer by tilting your phone.

title: Neon Hoops
description: Slingshot shots at a neon hoop against the clock. Swish for bonus time, catch fire on a streak, and sink a buzzer beater.

title: Deep Catch
description: Fishing from sunrise to sunset. Drop your line 400 m through eight ocean zones, fight each catch without snapping the line, spend your coins on upgrades, face the Leviathan, the Megalodon and the Kraken in the deep, and catch every species to unlock new boats and gear.

title: Hill Racer
description: Climb hills in a jeep, motorbike, quad bike and rally car across four areas. Collect coins and fuel, land flips and big air, grab power-ups, and upgrade every ride to level 10.

title: Chess
description: Full chess against a computer with three difficulty levels, or pass and play with a friend. Castling, en passant, promotion, hints and undo included.

title: Wave Survivor
description: Top-down wave-survival RPG. Pick one of 17 heroes, from Warrior and Mage to Necromancer and Engineer, each with its own attack, ability and passive. Level up, choose upgrades, and survive endless waves.
